page_title: RBL 2-1 EIN | RB Leipzig v Eintracht Frankfurt 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

90+3' Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Kevin Trapp.
90+2' We are about to witness a subsitution. El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) for Kevin Kampl.
90+1' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
90+1' Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) has a goal ruled out for offside!
89' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.

88' Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
88' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner.

88' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Maarten Vandevoordt thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. It will be a corner kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
87' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) was too forceful with his tackle and Benjamin Brand interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
86' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
85' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Nathaniel Brown.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Can Yilmaz Uzun.
84' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

84' The ball is cleared after Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes behind for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) is replacing Lois Openda.
81' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
81' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

80' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The ball goes out for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt can continue in their attacking effort.
80' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle after Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Eintracht Frankfurt have a free kick from a promising distance.
79' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
78' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.

77' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Maarten Vandevoordt easily catches the ball.
76' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is caught offside!
75' Eintracht Frankfurt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' Ansgar Knauff will be replaced by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
75' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Hugo Ekitike.
74' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches a cross from the corner, but Maarten Vandevoordt is alert to thwart the effort. Now Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.
74' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Eintracht Frankfurt get a corner.
74' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

74' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The linesman makes the right call and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a corner.
72' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
70' A yellow card for a tackle by Willi Orban (RB Leipzig). Benjamin Brand doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
70' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
69' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
68' The foul by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benjamin Brand.
68' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
67' It is time for a substitution. Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) is on for Xaver Schlager.
64' RB Leipzig control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
63' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and signals a foul after Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) brought his opponent down.
61' Benjamin Sesko picks out Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar.
60' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.

59' A brilliant individual effort! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
58' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
58' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) commits a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt win a free kick.
57' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul.
56' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
56' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. RB Leipzig will take a corner kick.
55' Unlucky! Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) hits a thunderous volley on the edge of the box that just flies just wide of the right post.
55' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Kevin Trapp easily makes the save.
52' Substitution. Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mahmoud Dahoud walks off.
51' 2 - 1 Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes into the bottom left corner.
51' Corner kick. Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) is ready to send the ball into the box.

50' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for RB Leipzig.
50' Today's referee Benjamin Brand rightly decides to book Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his harsh tackle.
49' Eintracht Frankfurt are ruled offside.
48' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
47' Neat passing move from RB Leipzig in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from RB Leipzig was in an offside position.
43' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

43' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and RB Leipzig manage to earn a corner.

40' 1 - 1 Can Yilmaz Uzun produces a killer pass to release Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt), who then unleashes a low drive from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the right post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 1:1!
38' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
37' Total attempts – 8:6.
35' The resulting set piece from RB Leipzig is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

35' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner.
35' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Kevin Trapp sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Eintracht Frankfurt comes to nothing.

32' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Eintracht Frankfurt are going to take it.
31' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires the ball from the free kick and it smashes against the crossbar!
31' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) makes a slide tackle, but referee Benjamin Brand blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
30' A snap shot by Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Maarten Vandevoordt produces a good save to thwart him.
28' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
27' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
26' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) makes a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.

23' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
23' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

22' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom right corner, but Kevin Trapp pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to RB Leipzig.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for RB Leipzig.
22' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
19' 1 - 0 Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is first to get to the rebound and heads home! Fantastic header from inside the box!
19' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Kevin Trapp easily deals with the threat.
17' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball would have probably ended inside the right post, if Kevin Trapp hadn't made a superb save.
16' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) tested Maarten Vandevoordt with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.

14' The ball rebounds out to Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
13' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.
13' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) tackles a bit over-zealously and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul. RB Leipzig win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
12' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
9' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
8' Great teamplay by Eintracht Frankfurt as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
6' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a strong challenge and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul.

5' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
4' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
2' A goal, which was scored by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig), was disallowed due to offside.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick-off.
Benjamin Brand is the one to supervise the game today.
